name: Adjoint Recurrence and Gradient Assembly
definition: A method to compute exact gradients of the discrete objective $J_{disc}$ with respect to parameters $\theta$ by solving an adjoint recurrence backwards in time, avoiding the storage of the full computational graph.
summary: Adjoint Recurrence and Gradient Assembly computes exact gradients for thermal tomography by solving an adjoint recurrence backwards in time, reducing memory complexity from O(K N_g N_t) to O(N_g) compared to naive backpropagation.
